title: Fig's Big Plan
note: b416 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs o-e, u-e.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar studying a gap between two leaves, looking thoughtful.
Fig the caterpillar gathering a few broad leaves and a thin plant stem.
Fig the caterpillar laying the stem carefully across the top of the gap.
The stem sliding sideways and falling away from the gap.
Fig the caterpillar pausing, looking at the fallen stem with a new idea forming.
Fig the caterpillar wrapping a thin leaf strand around the stem to hold it in place.
The stem staying firmly in place, tied securely with the leaf strand.
A small shelter formed from the leaves and tied stem, complete at last.
Fig the caterpillar sitting beside his finished leafy shelter, looking proud.
Fig the caterpillar sleeping peacefully inside his new leafy shelter.
